task: Add acceptance cases for DAEO-49o5 (W2-16) that cover the release-immutability behaviour the first review found, and show them failing first
status: DONE — commit `68cea1a4` adds 10 cases; all 10 fail for the reasons stated and the 75 earlier cases still pass
work_completed: Checked the setup first: `GOV_ROLE=independent-test-designer`, `GOV_TICKET=DAEO-49o5`, worktree `/home/usain/gov-os-worktrees/W2-16` on branch `w2/W2-16`. Wrote 10 cases (5 tests, 2 parameters each) in a new file and added their mapping to the README. Each case gives its KPI line, its source ("first review of W2-16, finding N") and the failure seen. No existing case changed. I did not read any of the implementation. The cases:
  1. `test_the_same_version_from_an_older_integration_commit_is_refused` (HEAD detached at the first release's record commit, or at the first release's own commit). KPI success 3 and success 1. Source: finding 1. Fails today: "`gov release 1.5.0` built a release although w2/integrate holds release 1.5.0's record…" (exit 0).
  2. `test_the_same_version_after_its_record_was_removed_is_refused` (first, second). KPI success 3. Source: finding 1. Fails today: "built a release although release <V>'s record was committed on w2/integrate and removed later" (exit 0).
  3. `test_the_same_version_as_an_existing_owner_tag_is_refused` (lightweight tag, annotated tag). KPI success 3 and success 2. Source: finding 1. Fails today: "built a release although the tag v1.4.0 already exists, on another commit" (exit 0). The review saw only the first two forms of finding 1 fail; this third form, a release over an existing tag, fails too.
  4. `test_a_version_differing_only_by_build_metadata_from_a_recorded_one_is_refused` (first, second). KPI success 3. Source: finding 4. Fails today: "`gov release 1.4.0+build.2` built a release although release 1.4.0 exists…" (exit 0).
  5. `test_a_release_never_hashes_bytes_the_commit_does_not_hold` (`--assume-unchanged`, `--skip-worktree`). KPI success 1. Source: finding 5. Fails today: exit 0, and the manifest lists `ticket.schema.json` with the edited bytes' hash `22865a7f…` instead of the committed blob's `186c1388…`.
files_changed: tests/acceptance/W2-16/test_w2_16_immutability.py (new); tests/acceptance/W2-16/README.md (header count, new mapping section, CAP-43 covers row)
evidence: `PYTHONPATH=/home/usain/gov-os-worktrees/W2-16/src python3 -c "import gov; print(gov.__file__)"` printed `/home/usain/gov-os-worktrees/W2-16/src/gov/__init__.py`. `/home/usain/Dynamic-Agentic-Engineering-OS/.git/hooks` holds only `*.sample` files. `git log --oneline -2`: `68cea1a4 W2-16 (DAEO-49o5): acceptance cases for release immutability found by the first review` / `38c8f1bb W2-16 (DAEO-49o5): checkpoint after verification (implementation 58869611 verified)`. The commit message has the trailers `Task: DAEO-49o5`, `Role: independent-test-designer`, `Implements: CAP-43.b`, `Rewrite-Reason: cases added after implementation, from the first review's findings 1, 4 and 5 (DEC-136)` and `Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>`. `git status --short` after the commit printed nothing (clean).
tests: New cases alone: `10 failed in 10.91s`. Whole suite, the command from the brief, without `-x`: `10 failed, 75 passed in 53.87s`, no skips. The 10 failures are exactly the new cases.
discoveries: A tag `v<V>` that already exists, with no record of V in the tree, is not refused today either. The review had reported only the older-checkout and removed-record forms.
risks: The finding-1 cases read "the repository already knows V" as any of three things: w2/integrate's history, an older checkout that w2/integrate contains, or an existing `v<V>` tag. If the engineer checks only one of these, the other cases stay red, which is intended. The build-metadata cases do not require `+build` versions to be accepted elsewhere, so refusing all build metadata would also pass them.
lessons: In the `releases` repository the first release has no older commit than the one it was built from, so the older-checkout case uses version 1.5.0. That keeps it away from "same version from the same commit", which no source decides.
proposed_decisions: none
unresolved: none
recommended_next_action: Hand the 10 red cases to the engineer for DAEO-49o5 to make green, then send the result to independent audit.
